stories.title: Disciplinary Signal Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the response schema for disciplinary history signals including fields for state_board_url, signal_present (boolean), supported_states (list), and disclaimer text. Ensure alignment with existing provider detail response structure.

stories.title: State Medical Board Link Resolution Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to map provider state to known medical board lookup URLs (DE, MS, VA currently supported) and return correct link based on provider location data from NPI lookup.

stories.title: Disciplinary Signal Presence Indicator
stories.description: Implement logic to determine and surface a disciplinary signal presence indicator based on availability of a state board lookup (not actual disciplinary records). Include clear disclaimer that full records are external.

stories.title: Evaluate Care API Integration
stories.description: Integrate disciplinary signal fields into provider detail response returned by evaluate_care_facade so frontend/chat can surface links and indicators consistently.

stories.title: Disciplinary Signal Tests and Edge Cases
stories.description: Create unit tests covering supported states, unsupported states (no link), missing provider state, and correct disclaimer inclusion. Validate no false implication of disciplinary action.
